before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read monthly sales and aggregate revenue by region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
region_revenue = df.groupby('region', as_index=True)['revenue'].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 7))
ax.pie(
    region_revenue.values,
    labels=region_revenue.index,
    autopct='%1.1f%%',
    startangle=90
)
ax.set_title("Share of Total Revenue by Region")
ax.axis('equal')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
